limitations: This collection concerns EPFO staff and staff pensioners who follow Central Government dearness allowance (DA) and dearness relief (DR) orders. It is not about EPF member benefits or EPS pensions.

Each EPFO circular forwards a Government OM and states the rate and its effective date. Effective dates are those stated in the circulars; the issue date is the EPFO circular date and is later than the effective date. Arrears, tax and pay-level details are not covered.

Each rate replaces the previous rate from its effective date; the earlier rate remains the rate for earlier periods. The 28% DA/DR (17% to 28%) and the 31% rate (28% to 31%) both state 1 July 2021, because the second order followed the first; the later order states the operative rate from that date and this history does not resolve how the overlap is applied.

The April 2020 circular freezes DA and DR at current rates and says the instalments due 1 Jan 2020, 1 Jul 2020 and 1 Jan 2021 will not be paid; the July 2021 circulars subsume them. No arrears are stated.
The 2016 circulars record the pre-7th-CPC rate of 125% from 1 Jan 2016 and the reset after the revised pay structure: DA/DR nil from 1 Jan 2016 and 2% from 1 Jul 2016.

The 1 October 2018 DR circular's rate (7% to 9% from 1 July 2018) is in the scanned image layer of the Government OM; the checked text evidence is the subject line. A second circular dated 25 May 2017 conveys the same OM as the 28 April 2017 DR circular and is not separately listed.
Earlier years (before 2016), the DA-linked allowance enhancements, gratuity enhancement, CGHS, family pension and pension revision circulars are not covered.
PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 3 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths that day; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR.
